---
title: "Modules: `EOSSDK_PlayerDataStorage` + `EOSSDK_TitleStorage` (+ FileTransferRequest handles)"
---

Tier A. File storage backed by the local filesystem (savepath). PlayerDataStorage = per-user read/write "cloud" saves; TitleStorage = read-only game-published files. 12 + 9 methods + 4-method transfer handles each.

## Common
`IRunCallback` only (no network). File backing via `FileManager` root = `savepath/userid/appid` (see `client.qmd`/settings). Chunked async transfers report progress through a `Read/WriteFileDataCallback` and return an `EOS_H*FileTransferRequest` handle for progress/cancel.

## `EOSSDK_PlayerDataStorage` (12)
Handle `EOS_HPlayerDataStorage`. `EmuInit` @`0x180124070` / `EmuDeinit` @`0x18012cda0`.
- **Metadata:** `QueryFile` @`0x180124eb0` (4 KB), `QueryFileList` @`0x1801260a0` (~4 KB), `GetFileMetadataCount`, `CopyFileMetadataAtIndex`/`ByFilename`.
- **Transfer:** `ReadFile` @`0x180128e10`, `WriteFile` @`0x1801296d0` (writes under savepath), `DuplicateFile` @`0x180127930` (2.6 KB), `DeleteFile` @`0x1801289b0`, `DeleteCache` @`0x180129b80`. Callback-infos `EOS_PlayerDataStorage_*CallbackInfo`.

## `EOSSDK_TitleStorage` (9)
Handle `EOS_HTitleStorage`. `EmuInit` @`0x180182620` / `EmuDeinit` @`0x180187020`.
- `QueryFile` @`0x180182d20`, `QueryFileList` @`0x1801840b0`, `ReadFile` @`0x1801859f0`, metadata copies, `DeleteCache`. **No WriteFile/DeleteFile** — read-only (title-published content).

## FileTransferRequest sub-handles (4 each)
`GetFileRequestState`, `GetFilename`, `CancelRequest`, `Release`. `EOSSDK_PlayerDataStorageFileTransferRequest` @`0x18012f...`, `EOSSDK_TitleStorageFileTransferRequest` @`0x18018a...`.

## Reimpl notes
- Reimpl: map filenames to files under the per-user save dir; PDS is read/write, TitleStorage read-only (from a game-content dir); chunked transfer with progress callbacks + cancelable request handle. Follow-ups: chunk size + progress semantics; encryption-key handling (PDS files may be EOS-"encrypted"); metadata fields (MD5, unencrypted size).
